extra.message: DOM-based XSS: the element at line 54 uses dangerouslySetInnerHTML with HTML returned by createInnerHTML() (line 26), which is built directly from the attacker-controlled URL fragment document.location.hash after only decodeURIComponent (line 27). Because the raw hash is inserted into the DOM without sanitization, an attacker can craft a URL such as '#' (see SAMPLE_ATTACK at line 6 and dangerousLinkTo at lines 12-15) and execute arbitrary JavaScript in the victim's browser.

cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
